title: Home, Hurt
text: {first} is home with one arm strapped to their chest and a dressing down the side of their face. The colony fusses. They hate it.

lines.text: "Don't. I saw it, that's the point. I saw it and I'm back. Next time I'll duck."

choices.label: "You're not going again."
choices.reply: "Watch me." They go anyway, the next time. You had known they would.

choices.label: "Rest. Then tell me what you saw."
choices.reply: They tell you all of it, that night, slowly, and leave nothing out. It's the longest you've ever talked.

notes: At home after the Crew Rover was lost (crew-hurt).
